battery: v2 (cases a-t, 2026-09-20): Phase 3 expanded the battery from 4 to 20 cases incl. shadow subset r/s/t. The gate rule is unchanged (all_cases_pass); the count follows the discovered battery. Phase 1 history (4/4 gates) is preserved in evals/runs/2026-09-19-*.
case_pass: A case passes when ALL hold: (1) the first decision token in the decision section is the expected one, (2) the first architectural-verdict token on architecture lines is within the allowed set, (3) the first soul-verdict token on soul lines is within the allowed set, (4) every plant is hit (file cited + one evidence token, plus a listed priority token when the plant declares priorities), (5) every control is respected.
frozen: Thresholds are declared before any scored run. Changing them after seeing results invalidates the comparison; record the change and re-run all conditions.

judge_agreement.metric: Exact item-level match rate between LLM-judge scores and evals/hand_scores.json over the validation set (12 live Phase 1 reviews + 4 synthetic bad reviews, 96 items). Plant levels (0/1/2) must match exactly.
judge_agreement.status: PRE-DECLARED before the first judge run (2026-09-20); the judge is untested until agreement is computed.

notes: Thresholds measure the mechanical grader's coarse lexical proxy, not review quality itself. Semantic verification (is the diagnosis correct, is the citation attached to the right claim) requires the Phase 2 calibrated judge.
